title: Velocity at C
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the block's speed at point C using energy conservation, accounting for friction on BC.

title: Heat on BC Segment
description: Important: Correctly computes the heat generated on the frictional BC segment using the work done by friction.

title: Conveyor Belt Analysis
description: Important: Correctly analyzes the two-phase motion on the conveyor belt (deceleration to belt speed, then acceleration with it).

title: Total Heat on Belt
description: Important: Correctly calculates the total heat generated on the conveyor belt using the total relative displacement and friction.

title: Final Ratio
description: Essential: Correctly states the final numerical ratio of heat generated in BC to heat generated on the conveyor belt.

title: Sign/Direction Error
description: Pitfall: Misapplies signs in kinematic equations for relative motion on the moving conveyor belt.

title: Energy Accounting
description: Pitfall: Fails to account for the initial kinetic energy of the block relative to the belt when calculating heat on the belt.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (J, m/s, m) throughout all calculations.
